_doc: FB-022 power-scale knobs. Every number here is a multiplier where 1.0 = the tuned default. Turn a knob up to make that part of the game stronger, down to make it weaker. Three layers multiply together: (1) the global knobs below, (2) each floor's own power_scale in world.json (enemies on that floor), (3) every single enemy and item's own power_scale in enemies.json / items.json. Changes apply on the next floor load; item knobs apply live, even to gear already in the bag.

champions._doc: FB-022: boss fights are more common. Champion lairs are combat rooms guarded by a promoted, named version of a regular enemy: a mini-boss with its own health bar, a roar, an enrage phase, and a guaranteed treasure drop. lair_every_rooms = one lair per this many combat rooms.
